domains: general vision, mobility and lighting; psychological adjustment; reading and fine work; activities of daily living
response_scale: 0-5 per item (5 = no difficulty, 1 = great difficulty, 0 = can no longer perform; not relevant = average score)
scoring: sum of items, 0 (low quality of life) to 125 (high)
validation_method: CTT; factor analysis; test-retest; internal consistency
target_population: adults (mostly elderly) with untreatable low vision
notes: Cronbach alpha 0.88; reliability 0.72 (p5); 74 pretested items reduced to 25 (p3-5); posted, phone or in-person; printed N20; outcome measure for rehabilitation, not a screening or accuracy study; completion time stated as 5 to 10 minutes (p9)
